name: CMM-GDT Benchmark
description: This repository provides the complete reproducibility package associated with the study “Risk-Controlled GD&T-Aware Active Sampling for Adaptive CMM Inspection of Free-Form Surfaces.”The software supports the generation and evaluation of simulation benchmarks for adaptive coordinate measuring machine (CMM) inspection of free-form surfaces. It focuses on geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), conformity-assessment risk, measurement uncertainty, and risk-controlled point-selection strategies.The package contains the Python source code, benchmark generators, baseline and Gaussian-process sampling methods, statistical analyses, robustness and sensitivity studies, computational-scaling experiments, external-data replay, automated tests, configuration files, figures, and generated numerical results.Six simulated surface families are included: sinusoidal panel, elliptic paraboloid, saddle surface, Gaussian bump panel, twisted blade-like surface, and mechanical platform with smooth transitions.The accompanying archive is intended to support transparency and computational reproducibility. The main study is simulation-based and does not constitute experimental validation on a physical CMM or evidence of immediate industrial deployment readiness.Licensing information is provided in the LICENSE file and in the source-specific documentation included in the archive. The original software, documentation, and generated results are released under the MIT License.
